questions.question: What is a computer?
questions.correctAnswer: A machine that follows instructions to process information
questions.explanation: A computer takes input, processes it, and gives output.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a computer follows instructions to work with information!

questions.question: Which of these is hardware?
questions.correctAnswer: A keyboard
questions.explanation: Hardware is the physical part of a computer you can touch.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: hardware is the part you can touch!

questions.question: Which of these is software?
questions.correctAnswer: A word processor app
questions.explanation: Software is the programs and apps that run on a computer.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: software is the programs inside the machine!

questions.question: What does the CPU do?
questions.correctAnswer: It is the brain of the computer that follows instructions
distractors: It shows pictures on the screen
questions.explanation: The CPU (central processing unit) carries out instructions.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the CPU is the computer's brain!

questions.question: What is a monitor used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To display information from the computer
questions.explanation: The monitor shows what the computer is doing.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the monitor shows you the computer's work!

questions.question: What is a keyboard used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To type letters, numbers, and commands
questions.explanation: The keyboard is an input device for typing.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the keyboard is for typing in!

questions.question: What is a mouse used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To point, click, and select things on the screen
questions.explanation: The mouse moves the pointer on the screen.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the mouse points and clicks!

questions.question: What is memory (RAM) in a computer?
questions.correctAnswer: Short-term storage the computer uses while it works
questions.explanation: RAM holds data the computer is using right now.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: RAM is the computer's short-term memory!

questions.question: What is a hard drive or SSD used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To store files and programs for a long time
questions.explanation: A hard drive or SSD keeps files even when the computer is off.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the hard drive keeps your files safe!

questions.question: What is a printer?
questions.correctAnswer: A device that puts computer files onto paper
questions.explanation: A printer makes paper copies of digital files.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a printer turns screen files into paper!

questions.question: What is a speaker used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To play sounds from the computer
questions.explanation: Speakers turn computer signals into sound you can hear.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: speakers play the computer's sounds!

questions.question: What is a tablet?
questions.correctAnswer: A portable computer with a touchscreen
questions.explanation: A tablet is a flat, portable computer you control by touching the screen.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a tablet is a computer you touch!

questions.question: What does a webcam do?
questions.correctAnswer: It captures video and photos for the computer
questions.explanation: A webcam lets you take photos and video chat.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a webcam is the computer's eye!

questions.question: Which device is an input device?
questions.correctAnswer: A microphone
questions.explanation: Input devices send information into the computer.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a microphone sends your voice in!

questions.question: Which device is an output device?
questions.correctAnswer: A monitor
questions.explanation: Output devices show or share information from the computer.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a monitor sends pictures out to you!

questions.question: What is an app?
questions.correctAnswer: A program that does a job on a computer or phone
questions.explanation: Apps are programs made to do specific tasks.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: an app is a program with a job to do!

questions.question: What is a file?
questions.correctAnswer: A collection of data saved under a name, like a document or photo
questions.explanation: Files store information like documents, photos, and songs.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a file is saved data with a name!

questions.question: What is a folder?
questions.correctAnswer: A place on a computer that holds files together
questions.explanation: Folders organize files so you can find them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: folders keep files organized!

questions.question: What does it mean to save a file?
questions.correctAnswer: To store your work so you can open it later
distractors: To send your work to a friend
questions.explanation: Saving stores your work on the computer.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: save your work so you never lose it!

questions.question: What is data?
questions.correctAnswer: Facts and information, like numbers, words, and pictures
questions.explanation: Data is information that computers store and use.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: data is information - numbers, words, pictures!

questions.question: What is the cloud?
questions.correctAnswer: Storage on the internet where files are kept
questions.explanation: Cloud storage keeps files on internet servers you can reach from anywhere.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the cloud is storage on the internet!

questions.question: What is a megabyte?
questions.correctAnswer: A unit that measures how much data a file holds
questions.explanation: Files are measured in bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, and gigabytes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a megabyte measures file size!

questions.question: Which file is probably the biggest?
questions.correctAnswer: A one-hour video
questions.explanation: Videos hold far more data than text or photos.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: video files are the biggest!

questions.question: What is a password?
questions.correctAnswer: A secret word that proves you are who you say you are
questions.explanation: Passwords protect your accounts from other people.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a password is your secret key!

questions.question: What makes a strong password?
questions.correctAnswer: A long mix of letters, numbers, and symbols that is hard to guess
questions.explanation: Strong passwords are long and hard to guess.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: long and mixed-up makes a strong password!

questions.question: What should you do if you forget your password?
questions.correctAnswer: Ask a parent or use the official reset with an adult's help
distractors: Share your account with a friend
questions.explanation: Password resets should be done with a trusted adult.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: forgot your password? Ask an adult for help!

questions.question: What is a username?
questions.correctAnswer: The name you use to identify yourself on a computer or website
questions.explanation: A username tells the computer who you are.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a username is how the computer knows it is you!

questions.question: What is a computer virus?
questions.correctAnswer: A harmful program that can damage files or steal information
distractors: A cold you catch from a screen
A kind of app for games
questions.explanation: Viruses are bad programs that harm computers.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a computer virus is a bad program that causes harm!

questions.question: What does antivirus software do?
questions.correctAnswer: It finds and removes harmful programs
questions.explanation: Antivirus software protects your computer from malware.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: antivirus is the guard against bad programs!

questions.question: What should you do before downloading a new app?
questions.correctAnswer: Ask a parent or teacher if it is safe
questions.explanation: Adults can help you check if an app is safe.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: ask an adult before downloading anything!

questions.question: What is an algorithm?
questions.correctAnswer: A step-by-step plan to solve a problem
questions.explanation: An algorithm is a clear list of steps, like a recipe.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: an algorithm is a recipe for solving a problem!

questions.question: Which of these is an algorithm?
questions.correctAnswer: The steps to make a sandwich
questions.explanation: A recipe is a step-by-step plan, just like an algorithm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a sandwich recipe is an algorithm!

questions.question: What is a sequence in coding?
questions.correctAnswer: Steps in the correct order
questions.explanation: Computers follow steps in order, so sequence matters.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: order matters - that is sequence!

questions.question: Why does the order of steps matter in an algorithm?
questions.correctAnswer: Doing steps in the wrong order gives the wrong result
distractors: It does not matter at all
It makes the computer faster only
questions.explanation: If you put on shoes before socks, you get a silly result!
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: wrong order, wrong result!

questions.question: What is a loop in coding?
questions.correctAnswer: Instructions that repeat again and again
distractors: A way to stop a program
questions.explanation: Loops repeat steps, like singing a chorus again.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a loop repeats the steps again and again!

questions.question: What is a bug in a computer program?
questions.correctAnswer: A mistake that makes the program work wrong
distractors: A real insect inside the computer
questions.explanation: A bug is an error in the code.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a bug is a mistake hiding in the code!

questions.question: What is debugging?
questions.correctAnswer: Finding and fixing mistakes in a program
questions.explanation: Debugging means hunting down bugs and fixing them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: debugging is bug hunting in code!

questions.question: What is a condition in coding?
questions.correctAnswer: An if-then rule, like 'if it rains, take an umbrella'
questions.explanation: Conditions let programs make choices.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: if this, then that - that is a condition!

questions.question: What does 'if it is raining, then take an umbrella' show?
questions.correctAnswer: A condition
questions.explanation: It is an if-then choice, which is a condition.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: if-then is a condition!

questions.question: What is a variable in coding?
questions.correctAnswer: A named box that stores a value that can change
questions.explanation: Variables store values, like a score in a game.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a variable is a labeled box that holds a value!

questions.question: In a game, the score goes up by 1 each time you win a point. What stores the score?
questions.correctAnswer: A variable
questions.explanation: The score is stored in a variable that changes.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the score lives in a variable!

questions.question: What is a function in coding?
questions.correctAnswer: A named block of code that does a job when you call it
questions.explanation: Functions group steps together so you can reuse them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a function is a reusable pack of steps!

questions.question: What is binary?
questions.correctAnswer: A number system using only 0 and 1
questions.explanation: Computers use binary because circuits are either on or off.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: binary is just zeros and ones!

questions.question: What does the binary digit 1 usually mean in a circuit?
questions.correctAnswer: On
questions.explanation: In binary, 1 means on and 0 means off.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: 1 means on, 0 means off!

questions.question: What is the binary number for 5?
questions.explanation: 5 in binary is 101 (4 + 0 + 1).
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: 5 is 101 in binary - 4 plus 1!

questions.question: What is a robot?
questions.correctAnswer: A machine that can sense, think, and act following a program
questions.explanation: Robots follow programs to do tasks, sometimes using sensors.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a robot senses, thinks, and acts!

questions.question: What is a sensor on a robot?
questions.correctAnswer: A part that detects things like light, touch, or distance
questions.explanation: Sensors let robots notice the world around them.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: sensors are a robot's senses!

questions.question: What is artificial intelligence (AI)?
questions.correctAnswer: Computer systems that can learn and solve problems like humans do
questions.explanation: AI programs learn from data to make decisions and predictions.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: AI is a computer that learns from examples!

questions.question: What is the first step in solving a coding problem?
questions.correctAnswer: Understand the problem and plan the steps
distractors: Type code as fast as you can
questions.explanation: Good coders plan before they type.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: plan first, code second!

questions.question: Which of these is the best way to test a program?
questions.correctAnswer: Run it and check if it does what you expected
questions.explanation: Testing means running the program and checking the result.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: run it and check - that is testing!

questions.question: What is the internet?
questions.correctAnswer: A worldwide network that connects computers
questions.explanation: The internet links computers all over the world.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the internet connects computers everywhere!

questions.question: What is a website?
questions.correctAnswer: A collection of pages on the internet you can visit
questions.explanation: Websites are pages stored on computers and shown in a browser.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a website is a place you visit on the internet!

questions.question: What is a web browser?
questions.correctAnswer: A program used to visit websites
questions.explanation: Browsers like Chrome show you web pages.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a browser is your window to the web!

questions.question: What is a search engine?
questions.correctAnswer: A tool that helps you find information on the internet
questions.explanation: Search engines find web pages that match your words.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a search engine finds answers on the web!

questions.question: What is an email?
questions.correctAnswer: A message sent over the internet to someone's inbox
distractors: A letter sent by post only
questions.explanation: Email is electronic mail sent between people.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: email is a letter sent through the internet!

questions.question: What is Wi-Fi?
questions.correctAnswer: A wireless way to connect to the internet
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi lets devices connect to the internet without wires.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Wi-Fi connects you without wires!

questions.question: What is a network?
questions.correctAnswer: Computers connected so they can share information
questions.explanation: A network links computers so they can talk to each other.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a network is computers talking to each other!

questions.question: What is a URL?
questions.correctAnswer: The address of a web page
questions.explanation: A URL tells the browser where to find a page.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a URL is a web page's address!

questions.question: What does 'https' at the start of a web address mean?
questions.correctAnswer: The connection is more secure
questions.explanation: HTTPS means the connection between you and the site is encrypted.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: https means a safer connection!

questions.question: What is a download?
questions.correctAnswer: Copying a file from the internet onto your device
questions.explanation: Downloading brings a file from the internet to you.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: downloading brings a file to your device!

questions.question: What is an upload?
questions.correctAnswer: Sending a file from your device to the internet
questions.explanation: Uploading sends your file up to the internet.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: uploading sends a file up to the internet!

questions.question: Why can the internet be slow sometimes?
questions.correctAnswer: Too many people using it, or a weak connection
questions.explanation: Heavy use or a weak signal slows the internet.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: too many users or a weak signal slows the web!

questions.question: What is streaming?
questions.correctAnswer: Watching or listening to media over the internet without downloading it
questions.explanation: Streaming plays video or music as it arrives.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: streaming plays as it arrives - no waiting for a download!

questions.question: What is a server?
questions.correctAnswer: A powerful computer that stores and shares information with other computers
questions.explanation: Servers hold websites and files and send them when asked.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a server is a super-computer that shares with others!

questions.question: What happens when you click a link?
questions.correctAnswer: The browser opens the new web page
questions.explanation: Links take you to another page.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a link is a door to another page!

questions.question: What should you never share online?
questions.correctAnswer: Your full name, address, school, or passwords
questions.explanation: Personal information can be used by strangers to find or trick you.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: keep personal info private - never share it online!

questions.question: What is a trusted adult online?
questions.correctAnswer: A parent, teacher, or guardian you can ask for help
questions.explanation: Trusted adults help you stay safe online.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a trusted adult is your online safety helper!

questions.question: What should you do if a stranger messages you online?
questions.correctAnswer: Do not reply and tell a trusted adult
questions.explanation: Strangers online can be unsafe; tell an adult.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: stranger message? Do not reply - tell an adult!

questions.question: What is cyberbullying?
questions.correctAnswer: Using the internet to hurt, scare, or embarrass someone
questions.explanation: Cyberbullying is bullying that happens online.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: cyberbullying is bullying through screens!

questions.question: What should you do if someone is mean to you online?
questions.correctAnswer: Save the message, block them, and tell a trusted adult
questions.explanation: Saving evidence and telling an adult stops cyberbullying.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: save it, block them, tell an adult!

questions.question: What is a digital footprint?
questions.correctAnswer: The trail of things you do and share online
questions.explanation: Everything you post online can stay there for a long time.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: your digital footprint is your online trail!

questions.question: Why should you think before you post something online?
questions.correctAnswer: It can stay online for a long time and be seen by many people
questions.explanation: Once posted, things can be copied and shared.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: think before you post - the internet remembers!

questions.question: What is a pop-up ad?
questions.correctAnswer: A small window that appears, often trying to sell something
questions.explanation: Pop-ups appear on websites and often advertise things.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: pop-ups are little ad windows that jump up!

questions.question: What should you do if a pop-up asks for your password?
questions.correctAnswer: Close it and tell a trusted adult
questions.explanation: Real sites never ask for passwords in pop-ups.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: never type your password into a pop-up!

questions.question: What is phishing?
questions.correctAnswer: A trick message that tries to steal your information
distractors: A kind of email from a friend
questions.explanation: Phishing messages pretend to be real to steal passwords.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: phishing is a trick to steal your info!

questions.question: How can you tell if a website might be unsafe?
questions.correctAnswer: It asks for personal information, has strange spelling, or looks suspicious
questions.explanation: Unsafe sites often ask for private info or look odd.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: strange requests and sloppy spelling mean be careful!

questions.question: What is good digital citizenship?
questions.correctAnswer: Using technology kindly, safely, and responsibly
questions.explanation: Good digital citizens are kind and careful online.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: be kind, safe, and responsible online!

questions.question: Why should you not believe everything you read online?
questions.correctAnswer: Some information online is false or misleading
questions.explanation: Anyone can post online, so check facts with trusted sources.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: check facts - not everything online is true!

questions.question: What should you do if a game asks you to spend real money?
questions.correctAnswer: Ask a parent before spending anything
questions.explanation: Real money in games needs a parent's okay.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: real money in games means ask a parent first!

questions.question: What is the best rule for meeting someone you only know online?
questions.correctAnswer: Never meet them in person without a parent
distractors: Keep it secret from your parents
questions.explanation: Online friends are strangers until a parent says otherwise.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: online friends stay online - never meet alone!

questions.question: What is a pattern?
questions.correctAnswer: Something that repeats in a regular way
questions.explanation: Patterns repeat, like red, blue, red, blue.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: patterns repeat again and again!

questions.question: What comes next in this pattern: 2, 4, 6, 8, ___?
questions.explanation: The pattern adds 2 each time: 8 + 2 = 10.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: add 2 each time - 10 comes next!

questions.question: What comes next in this pattern: 5, 10, 15, 20, ___?
questions.explanation: The pattern adds 5 each time: 20 + 5 = 25.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: add 5 each time - 25 comes next!

questions.question: What is a chart used for?
questions.correctAnswer: To show information in a clear, visual way
questions.explanation: Charts turn numbers into pictures that are easy to read.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: charts make information easy to see!

questions.question: What is a bar graph?
questions.correctAnswer: A chart that uses bars to compare amounts
distractors: A chart that uses a circle
questions.explanation: Bar graphs show amounts with bars of different heights.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: bars show amounts at a glance!

questions.question: If a bar graph shows 5 apples, 8 bananas, and 3 oranges, which fruit is most common?
questions.correctAnswer: Bananas
questions.explanation: The tallest bar is bananas with 8.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the tallest bar wins - bananas!

questions.question: What is sorting?
questions.correctAnswer: Putting things in order, like smallest to largest
questions.explanation: Sorting arranges data in order.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: sorting puts things in order!

questions.question: Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest: 9, 3, 7, 1
questions.explanation: Smallest to largest means start with the smallest number.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: smallest first - 1, 3, 7, 9!

questions.question: What is an input in a computer program?
questions.correctAnswer: Information or data given to the program
questions.explanation: Inputs go into a program; outputs come out.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: input goes in, output comes out!

questions.question: What is an output in a computer program?
questions.correctAnswer: The result the program shows or produces
questions.explanation: Outputs are what the program gives back.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: output is what the program gives back!

questions.question: A vending machine takes your coins and gives you a snack. What is the input?
questions.correctAnswer: The coins you put in
questions.explanation: The coins are the input; the snack is the output.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: coins in is the input, snack out is the output!

questions.question: What does a computer need to work?
questions.correctAnswer: Hardware, software, and electricity
questions.explanation: A computer needs its parts, programs, and power.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: parts plus programs plus power!

questions.question: How do computers store pictures?
questions.correctAnswer: As data made of tiny dots called pixels
questions.explanation: Pictures are stored as grids of tiny colored dots.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: pictures are stored as tiny dots called pixels!

questions.question: What is a pixel?
questions.correctAnswer: A tiny dot of color that makes up a picture on a screen
questions.explanation: Many pixels together make the images you see.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: pixels are the tiny dots that build pictures!

questions.question: What is a robot's program?
questions.correctAnswer: Instructions that tell the robot what to do
questions.explanation: Programs control what robots do.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a program is the robot's instruction list!

questions.question: Which of these can AI do?
questions.correctAnswer: Learn from examples to recognize patterns
questions.explanation: AI finds patterns in data, but it is not alive and does not feel.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: AI learns patterns from examples!

questions.question: Why do programmers test their code?
questions.correctAnswer: To find and fix mistakes before others use it
questions.explanation: Testing catches bugs early.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: test to catch bugs before others find them!

questions.question: What is the best first step when your program does not work?
questions.correctAnswer: Check your code step by step to find the mistake
questions.explanation: Debugging step by step finds the problem.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: check step by step to find the bug!

questions.question: What is an event in coding?
questions.correctAnswer: Something that happens, like a click, that starts an action
questions.explanation: Events like clicks or key presses trigger code.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a click is an event that starts an action!

questions.question: What have you learned about computers in this pack?
questions.correctAnswer: Computers follow instructions using hardware and software to work with data
questions.explanation: Computers are tools that follow human instructions.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: computers follow instructions - people are the real brains!
